ModMetaData.name: RimworldMP
ModMetaData.author: RimworldMP contributors
ModMetaData.description: From-scratch RimWorld 1.7 multiplayer (shared colony, LAN TCP, in-game host). Phase 1: host lobby + client join, lockstep commands (pause/speed, draft, jobs, zones, restrict areas), seeded Rand hooks, hash desync freeze. Requires Harmony 3. Build with RIMWORLD_DIR for full Verse patches.
